note: Re-judged (independent auditor). The prior weak finding (no tagged unit reached writeAVPRandomVector, so a Random Vector with M=0 in the PAP realm ICCN stayed green) is resolved by the new tag on rfc2661_iccn_proxy_flags_test.go::TestRFC2661ProxyICCNAVPFlags. Section 4.4.1, Random Vector: "The M-bit for this AVP MUST be set to 1." The unit builds both proxy ICCNs through the real producers (newICCNProxy then writeICCNBody: PAP with a shared secret, and CHAP), walks every AVP and compares its M bit to the Section 4.4 definition (rfc2661MandatoryBit for Message Type, Tx Connect Speed, Framing Type; Random Vector M=1, AVPs 26 to 33 M=0), fails on an AVP absent from both tables, and requires the PAP body to carry the Random Vector and AVP 33, so the walk cannot pass by not reaching the proxy path. Producer read: writeAVPRandomVector writes FlagMandatory; the mutant record replacing FlagMandatory by 0 on that line is observed red. TestRFC2661WrittenAVPFlags (the ten writers) and TestRFC2661HelloAVPMandatoryBits (HELLO) still cover every other emitted body. {single-polarity} accepted: a sender obligation with no receiver refusal in the RFC.
